description: This file contains Bash shell script functions and case statements for handling firmware upgrade procedures specific to Buffalo devices with MT7622 chipset, including validation, upgrade processes, and U-Boot behavior descriptions.

methods.name: buffalo_check_image
methods.description: Validates a firmware image for the Buffalo device, checking for correct format and compatibility based on the kernel partition size and image headers.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process for TRX + UBI formatted images, including detaching UBI, erasing the firmware partition, and writing the new image.

methods.name: buffalo_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher that chooses between UBI upgrade or NAND upgrade based on the image's magic number.
